purpose: Teach: 飛行場/プロパティ/アダルト/宇宙船/エルサレム/ミュンヘン/インスタント/イタリアン

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さん、お母さんを飛行場までお見送りしたの
lines.en: Sho, we took Mom to the airport and saw her off.
lines.style: Warm, gently present recollection. Soft opening, as though inviting him to remember with her. Low pace. A small smile at the edge of her voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、お家のホームページのプロパティって何?
lines.en: Mei-sis, what does 'property' mean on the home page?
lines.style: Bright, genuine curiosity with a slight hesitation mid-sentence. The kind of question that arrives unfiltered. Quick, eager to understand.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、アダルト向けのお店は子供は入っちゃダメよ
lines.en: Sho, there are some shops that aren't for children to go into.
lines.style: Gentle but clear boundary. No harshness—protective, matter-of-fact. The way an older sister explains the world without making him feel foolish for asking.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、宇宙船のおもちゃ大好きだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I really love spaceship toys!
lines.style: Bright declaration with genuine enthusiasm. Open-mouthed energy on the word 'love.' Small, unselfconscious joy. The eagerness of wanting to share something that delights him.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、エルサレムって聖地らしいわよ
lines.en: Sho, Jerusalem is supposed to be a holy place, you know.
lines.style: Thoughtful, teaching tone. Slight pause before the explanation, as though offering him something interesting. Warm but observant—the way she notices what might catch his attention.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、お父さんがミュンヘンに出張に行くんだって
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad's going on a business trip to Munich.
lines.style: Eager relay of information, the way a child shares news that felt important to him. Quick pace, slight lift at the end—checking if she finds it interesting too.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、インスタントラーメン作ろうか?
lines.en: Sho, want to make some instant ramen together?
lines.style: Soft, inviting offer. Gentle opening with warmth underneath. Slight downward lilt at the end—a question that's already half-decided, an invitation more than a demand.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、イタリアンのお店、行きたいな
lines.en: Mei-sis, I want to go to an Italian restaurant.
lines.style: Hopeful small voice with a soft, wishing quality. The slight hesitation of wanting something but being unsure. Open-ended, as if testing whether she'll say yes.
